name: Neba (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Neba village emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised arrow, with a star at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Neba, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Neba village emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised arrow, with a star at the top
